title: 2.1 Using Fundamental Identities

icans: I can recognize and write the fundamental trigonometric identities.
I can use the fundamental identities to evaluate trig functions.
I can use the fundamental identities to simplify, factor, and add trig expressions.

vocab: csc u = ______________,  sec u = 1/cos u,  cot u = 1/tan u
tan u = ______________,  cot u = cos u/sin u
sin²u + cos²u = ______________,  1 + tan²u = sec²u,  1 + cot²u = csc²u
cos(−u) = cos u (even); sin, tan, csc, cot of −u = −(the ___________) (odd)
